title: 500 Miles on Mosaic’s New 32″ Shows How Big Wheels Can Unlock Gravel’s Full Potential
content:
From racing Big Sugar to riding loose desert switchbacks, Mosaic’s GT i55 32 is the first bike to prove 32-inch wheels can challenge the status quo.

Read the full article at 500 Miles on Mosaic’s New 32″ Shows How Big Wheels Can Unlock Gravel’s Full Potential on Velo.
author: Logan Jones-Wilkins
